title: Insurers’ role will be critical in improving cybersecurity standards
summary: The rise in the cost of cyber breaches and the increase in reported incidents are driving greater demand for cybersecurity insurance, as is the growing number of cyber-related exclusions being put into Directors and Officers (D&O) liability insurance and Professional Indemnity (PI) insurance. This is against a backdrop of increasingly strong regulation and legislation such as the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the forthcoming Network and Information Security Directive (NISD), each designed to drive organizations to take cybersecurity more seriously.
